faults.title: Piston ring failure on early petrols (Mk7)
faults.description: Some early 2015-on Astra K petrol engines suffered piston ring failure. Auto Express says using Dexos 2 spec oil rather than Dexos 1 is key to avoiding it, so check the service records.

faults.title: Fuel gauge under-reading (Mk7)
faults.description: The fuel gauge on early Astra Ks could read lower than the actual level. Software updates should have sorted most cars by now.

faults.title: 1.4 turbo flat spot (Mk7)
faults.description: The 1.4 turbo petrol can hesitate around 3,000rpm, particularly under load.

faults.title: Worn clutches and noisy front suspension (Mk7)
faults.description: Auto Express says clutches worn out at low mileage and noisy front suspension are worryingly common on the Mk7.

faults.title: Braking and airbag recalls (Mk7)
faults.description: The Astra K has been recalled four times, including a December 2018 campaign covering over 37,000 cars for braking faults, plus recalls for airbags and poorly welded seat frames.
